description: The bar chart illustrates the performance comparison between two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three distinct audio reasoning tasks: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni, as evaluated on the MMAR benchmark. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 0% to 70% with tick marks at 10% intervals. The horizontal axis lists the three tasks, each represented by a pair of adjacent bars — blue for MMAU and purple for MMAR — as indicated by the legend in the top-left corner. In Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, MMAU achieves approximately 49% accuracy while MMAR reaches about 30%. In Audio-Reasoner, MMAU scores around 61% and MMAR approximately 36%. In Qwen2.5-Omni, MMAU attains roughly 64% accuracy, and MMAR reaches about 56%. Across all tasks, MMAU consistently outperforms MMAR, with the largest performance gap observed in Qwen2-Audio-Instruct and the smallest in Qwen2.5-Omni. The bars are grouped by task and are not sorted by value, maintaining the task order as presented. No additional annotations, error bars, or shading are present.
